english.title: Make a false statement to obtain a licence / consent for a section 20(6) of the Energy Act 2008 requirement
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) made a statement which you knew to be, or recklessly made a statement which was, false in order to obtain

(A)_[a licence under section 4]_
(B)_[the consent of the licensing authority for the purpose of a requirement imposed by virtue of section 20(6)]_
(C)_[the consent of **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) for the purpose of a requirement imposed by virtue of section 20(6)]_

of the Energy Act 2008, namely **(..SPECIFY FALSE STATEMENT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 23(5) and (7) of the Energy Act 2008.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
knowingly / recklessly made a false statement
in order to obtain

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Proceedings must either be instituted by the Secretary of State or a person authorised by the Sec of State or by or with the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
